question_text: Were there any tracked objects (by object_id) that were detected at Gate_MainEntrance AND also at KeynoteHall_DoorA on 2025-12-08? If so, how many unique objects appeared at both locations?

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.object_id) FROM events a JOIN events b ON a.object_id = b.object_id WHERE a.camera_location = 'Gate_MainEntrance' AND b.camera_location = 'KeynoteHall_DoorA' AND a.event_type IN ('person_entry','person_exit') AND b.event_type IN ('person_entry','person_exit') AND a.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND a.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AND b.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND b.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.tests: multi-hop: object traversal across cameras via DETECTED_BY relationships
